review_notes:
I read the whole file and checked its definitions against Mathlib concepts. The new definitions are CanonicalDifferentDegree, HurwitzCanonicalDecomposition, tameDifferentDivisor, LocalHurwitzExponent, CanonicalDivisorVariationPrincipal, restrictDCoord, TameLocalDifferentExponent and LocalUnitDerivativeRegular. All of them encode curve-specific notions about canonical divisors, ramification and places. These are the project's own divisor-on-places setting. I found no Mathlib definition that represents the same concept. In particular, Mathlib's different ideal is a different object from the tame different divisor with exponent e-1.

kaehlerMap is an abbrev for KaehlerDifferential.map K K F F'. It is a named, transparent specialisation, and the rubric says not to treat those as defects. Later theorems mix the abbrev with the raw KaehlerDifferential.map, but because it is an abbrev this causes no real conversion cost.

Several theorems restate general valuation facts: Place.ord_neg', Place.ord_pow', Place.ord_natCast', ord_add_eq_min' and Divisor.degree_eq_zero_of_isPrincipal'. These are standalone theorem duplication, which the rubric excludes.

The LocalUnitDerivativeRegular hypothesis is written out in full in the RHEngine theorems instead of using the definition. That repeats a statement inside this file, not a competing Mathlib concept, so it is out of scope. No finding.
